title: POS Contact Info Chart
narration: This chart highlights key statistics demonstrating the importance of collecting customer contact information at the point of sale.  A significant 68% of consumers are more likely to return to a business if they receive a personalized offer, while 60% of businesses with active data collection experience revenue growth.  Furthermore, 72% are willing to share their information for value, and 47% prefer text updates, showcasing the potential of digital channels.
